metadata.summary: The case involved the Income-tax Appellate Tribunal referring questions of law under section 256(1) of the Income-tax Act, 1961 to the Allahabad High Court. The matter related to the assessment year 1974-75 and concerned undisclosed business transactions of the assessee. The High Court found that the assessee had adequately explained the cash credits in question, leading to the Tribunal's decision to reverse the order of the AAC. Consequently, the first question was answered in favor of the assessee, rendering the second question moot. No costs were awarded in the case.
